extensionProtocol.diagnosticScope: Fixed executed paper ledger arithmetic and excursions; no causal attribution, no claimed tradable MFE counterfactual

extensionProtocol.independentExecution: Reuse unchanged research execution, sizing and cost scenarios. For breakout/pullback target is a checkpoint, not full take profit; common 48h max hold. No book/spread history outside recovered Strict entry snapshots, so liquidity remains a previous-bar-volume proxy.

independentStrategies.donchian-breakout: Completed 5m close > preceding 20-bar high; volume >1.5x preceding 20-bar mean; completed hourly EMA20>EMA50; stop close-2ATR14(5m); target checkpoint close+3 structural R; 1.5R runner after checkpoint
independentStrategies.mean-reversion: Previous close below previous lower Bollinger20(2 population stdev); current close reclaims lower band; RSI14<=40; last completed hourly close>=EMA50; stop 5-bar low-0.5ATR14(5m); exit target EMA20
independentStrategies.trend-pullback: Hourly EMA20>EMA50; previous 5m close<=previous EMA20 and current close>EMA20; RSI14 in [40,60]; stop lowest recent 5-bar low-0.5ATR14(5m); checkpoint 3 structural R; 1.5R runner

extensionProtocol.indicatorConventions: Recomputed EMA over latest 600 contiguous 5m bars, hourly EMA over latest 50 complete UTC hours; SMA RSI14; gap resets 5m indicator history; aggregate hours require all 12 bars; independent entries are rising edges; signal availability candle close +1ms
extensionProtocol.inference: Existing aggregate outcomes through Nov4 were already viewed. Extension is chronological retrospective evidence, not pristine blind holdout. Independent rules fixed before their outcomes, but historical windows remain exploratory. No parameter optimization and no winner selection.
extensionProtocol.safety: Research branch only; no frozen source/protocol edits, no live mutation, no orders, no merge

accountAudit.note: Point-in-time snapshot, not historical account series. Research baseline 300 EUR differs from current balance. No account writes.

caveats: All historical outcomes have previously existed: this is retrospective OOS, not pristine prospective evidence.
Fixed variants; no automatic selection or refitting on validation.
Journal is limited to the contemporaneously selected deep-market universe, with selection bias.
Historical quotes/books recovered at entry points when contexts are present; no continuous order-book/trade tape or historical instrument precision metadata; execution remains modeled.
Conflicting cross-source candle vintages are preserved and logged; original Oct31 cache is selected first, then API cache, then snapshot; affected windows are not clean evidence.
OHLCV gaps can mean no trades or missing data; never forward-filled.
48h holding limit changes frozen model economics; research proxies must not be named frozen Strict/Adaptive equivalents.
Missing held bars contaminate complete portfolio runs; results not eligible as evidence.
No winner: small samples, costs and market regimes require further prospective validation.
